inlines.v: APPRE'CIATE, verb transitive apprishate. [Latin ad and pretium, value, price. See Price.] 1. To value; to set a price or value on; to estimate; as, we seldom sufficiently appreciate the advantages we enjoy. 2. To raise the value of. Lest a sudden peace should appreciate the money. APPRE'CIATE, verb intransitive To rise in value; to become of more value; as, the coin of the country appreciates; public securities appreciated, when the debt was funded.
